tgs_velocity_semantics: Reported dq is end-of-step solver velocity; whole-step fd(q)/dt is an estimator and never a rejection by itself.
finger_policy: preserve native finger gains, force modes, targets and state; send full nine-dimensional effort buffer
applied_readback: command buffer only; not a physical torque sensor
model_scope: mounted-tool 9-coordinate M/c/g are observations; no invented L-tool inertia; model-based control remains conditional
